story: The Crooked Lantern was a small tavern at the edge of the Thornwood. Nobody went into the forest after dark. Everybody knew why.

Mira worked there every night. She cleaned the tables, carried bowls of hot stew and cups of ale, and kept the fire in the hearth alive. The innkeeper, old Bram, was kind but tired, and he always said the same thing: “Keep the door closed and the candles lit.”
That night it was raining. The tavern was warm and loud. Then the door opened, and the room went quiet.
A stranger walked in. He wore a long black cloak, and a hood hid his face. Water ran from his cloak onto the floor, but his boots were dry. Mira noticed that. She always noticed small things.
He sat down at the table near the hearth. Mira brought him a bowl of stew and a cup of ale.
“Thank you,” he said. His voice was soft, almost like music. For a second she saw his eyes under the hood. They were silver, like the moon.
He did not eat. He only watched the fire.
When he stood up to leave, he put a coin on the table. It was gold, and it was warm.
“For your kindness,” he said. “Keep it. You will need it.”
Bram looked at the coin, and his face went white. “Throw it in the fire, girl,” he whispered. “Nothing from the forest is free.”
But Mira closed her hand around the coin and put it in her pocket.

grammar.title: Прошедшее время: Past Simple
grammar.text:
Почти вся история рассказана в прошедшем времени. was / were — «был / были»: The tavern was warm, his boots were dry.

Обычные глаголы получают -ed: work → worked, clean → cleaned, notice → noticed, carry → carried (y меняется на i).

Самые частые глаголы — неправильные, их запоминают: go → went, see → saw, sit → sat, wear → wore, run → ran, stand → stood, say → said, bring → brought, know → knew.

Отрицание — через did not + обычная форма: He did not eat — «Он не ел».
